checkpoint: strict own scratch FINAL20/defaulthead; original student unchanged
selection: First2 original cache entries per TX/RX/day for step; next2 for response; both historically seen L, never independent held-out validation
channel: raw to complete residual/post_sync/noEQ/ref30/reflect; native quality/sync/IQ compensation/AGC recomputed; no ordinary stacked
model_mode: eval with autograd; original .grad None; not stochastic training reconstruction
lookahead_gradient: .5 g_raw(theta)+.5 mean(g_mid,g_low)(theta_after_raw_step); detached first order; no Hessian term
default_head: existing jointly updated cosine6x160 scale30; no new head

qualification.rule: For each B0/B1, lookahead beats joint mean response mid/low CE by >1e-6; response raw CE no worse than joint by >1e-6; at least4/6 response batches improve urban CE; only mechanistic support, not performance/E50
qualification.on_fail: close this fixed fresh-Adam raw-lookahead rationale; no step-size/inner-state/seed rescue
